# owner: platform
"""Find stretches of opening hours nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def check_inside(worked: List[Span], opening: Span):
    """Raise ValueError if a span leaves opening hours."""
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < opening.start:
            raise ValueError(outside_text(span, opening))
        if span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(outside_text(span, opening))


def outside_text(span: Span, opening: Span) -> str:
    return (f"{format_span(span)} is outside "
            f"opening hours {format_span(opening)}")


def uncovered(worked: List[Span], opening: Span) -> List[Span]:
    """Parts of opening hours that no worked span touches."""
    found = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in merge_spans(worked):
        if span.start > cursor:
            found.append(Span(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        found.append(Span(cursor, opening.end))
    return found


def format_gap(span: Span) -> str:
    return f"gap {format_span(span)} ({span.minutes} min)"


def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, for example
    "gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)". Raises ValueError when a worked
    span falls outside opening hours."""
    worked = list(worked)
    check_inside(worked, opening)
    return [format_gap(gap) for gap in uncovered(worked, opening)]
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps

OPEN = "09:00-17:00"


def gaps_for(worked, opening=OPEN):
    spans = [parse_span(text) for text in worked]
    return find_gaps(spans, parse_span(opening))


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        result = gaps_for(["09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"])
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        result = gaps_for(["10:00-11:00"], "09:00-12:30")
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
            "gap 11:00-12:30 (90 min)"
        ])

    def test_no_workers_means_whole_day(self):
        result = gaps_for([], "09:00-10:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_overlap_leaves_no_gap(self):
        result = gaps_for(["09:00-13:00", "12:00-17:00"])
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_touching_spans_leave_no_gap(self):
        result = gaps_for(["09:00-12:00", "12:00-17:00"])
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_unsorted_input(self):
        result = gaps_for(["14:00-15:00", "09:00-10:00"],
                          "09:00-15:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 10:00-14:00 (240 min)"])

    def test_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        for text in ("08:00-10:00", "16:00-18:00"):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    gaps_for([text])
EOF

before.CHANGES.txt:
## Unreleased
- Clearer wording when a span ends before it starts.

## 0.7.1 (2026-07-08)
- normalize_day accepts full day names in any case.

## 0.7.0 (2026-04-22)
- Add format_day_line and day_coverage.
- worker_minutes no longer merges overlaps for the same worker.

## 0.6.0 (2025-12-15)
- Read schedules from CSV.

## 0.5.0 (2025-09-30)
- Add intersect_spans. Touching spans no longer count as overlapping.
before.docs/api.txt:
hourglass.parsing.parse_clock(text): read a clock time as minutes since midnight
hourglass.parsing.format_clock(minutes): minutes since midnight as HH:MM
hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text): read a range such as 09:00-17:30
hourglass.parsing.format_span(span): a span as start-end text
hourglass.parsing.normalize_day(text): short lowercase day name
hourglass.merging.spans_overlap(first, second): whether two spans share any time
hourglass.merging.intersect_spans(first, second): the part two spans share
hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans): collapse overlaps into a sorted list
hourglass.merging.total_minutes(spans): minutes covered, overlaps counted once
hourglass.schedule.parse_schedule_text(text): parse schedule CSV held in memory
hourglass.schedule.load_schedule(path): read a schedule CSV from disk
hourglass.schedule.shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker): all shifts for one worker
hourglass.schedule.worker_minutes(shifts): scheduled minutes per worker
hourglass.schedule.day_coverage(shifts, day): merged spans for a day
hourglass.schedule.format_day_line(shifts, day): one text line for a day
